categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the LED industry, focusing on manufacturing and selling LED components, LED modules, and LED lighting products. It also engages in real estate development and investment. The LED business includes LED components such as visible and invisible light LEDs, LED lighting fixtures for outdoor, commercial, and automotive applications, and ODM/ODM services for smart lighting modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in downstream LED packaging and assembly, utilizing expertise in optical design, heat dissipation, and material properties to enhance LED performance. Production involves automated processes including chip bonding, wire bonding, dispensing, baking, and packaging. The company also develops high-power LEDs and integrates advanced packaging technologies like SMD, PLCC, and COB. R&D focuses on improving product quality, diversifying product lines, and developing power semiconductor devices such as IGBT.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and commercial lighting sectors. The company serves markets requiring LED components for displays, indicators, lighting fixtures, automotive lighting modules, and smart lighting applications. Major end markets are in Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with a focus on emerging markets in Southeast Asia and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, China (Nanjing, Lianyungang), Myanmar (Yangon), India, Hong Kong, and the United States. Sales are concentrated in Asia (about 78%), with additional markets in the Americas and Europe. Production facilities are strategically located in Taiwan, China, and Myanmar to leverage cost advantages and regional market access.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the LED supply chain, specializing in LED chip packaging, module assembly, and finished lighting products. It procures upstream materials such as sapphire substrates and epitaxial wafers from suppliers but focuses on value-added packaging and module integration for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value, diversified LED products, expanding into power semiconductor devices like IGBT, and enhancing smart lighting solutions. The company invests in R&D to improve product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate new product development cycles. It emphasizes collaboration with research institutes and aims to strengthen its global sales network, especially in emerging markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of LED components, LED modules, and lighting products. The company also earns income from real estate development activities. Sales channels include direct sales, distributors, and OEM/ODM partnerships, with a focus on expanding market share through product innovation and geographic expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international LED manufacturers such as Baihong Industrial, Lichi Electronics, and Hongqi Technology. It positions itself as a downstream LED packaging specialist with a strong R&D capability and a diversified product portfolio. The company leverages cost advantages from overseas production bases and aims to differentiate through quality and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$655 million, a 13.7% decline from the previous year, with a gross margin around 23.7%. The company experienced operating and net losses due to market challenges but improved its net loss per share compared to the prior year. R&D expenses accounted for about 4.25% of revenue. The company maintains assets totaling over NT$2.3 billion and equity exceeding NT$1.2 billion, with ongoing investments in production capacity and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive in-house R&D capabilities, advanced packaging technologies, and ability to produce high-power and specialized LED products. It offers diversified product lines tailored to various applications including automotive, industrial, and smart lighting markets. Cost competitiveness is enhanced through overseas manufacturing bases, while quality and service are supported by certifications and strong customer relationships. The company aims to provide innovative, high-value LED solutions that meet evolving market demands.
